text: Account security: the customer reports or strongly suspects account compromise, fraud or unauthorized activity anywhere in the ticket.
label: trust_safety

text: Service outage: the customer reports Tallyfern itself is down or broadly failing, anywhere in the ticket.
label: incident_response

text: Chargeback or bank dispute: a chargeback or card/bank dispute has been filed, anywhere in the ticket, even if the main request is a refund.
label: billing_disputes

text: Large or late refund: the main request is a refund and the amount is more than $500 or the charge was more than 30 days ago.
label: finance_review

text: Standard refund: any other refund request ($500 or less, 30 days or less, or amount or timing not given).
label: billing_refunds

text: Failed or missing payout: the customer's own payout failed, is late or arrived short.
label: payments_ops

text: Legacy API error: an API error on the v1 API.
label: legacy_api

text: API error: any other API error (v2, or version not given).
label: api_support

text: Enterprise SSO sign-in: the customer can't sign in and the account is enterprise with SSO enabled.
label: enterprise_identity

text: Sign-in problem: any other sign-in problem, including enterprise accounts without SSO.
label: account_access

text: EU/UK data request: the customer asks for a copy or deletion of their data and the account region is eu or uk.
label: privacy_legal

text: Larger plan change: the customer wants to change plan or seats and the account has 50 or more seats or is on enterprise.
label: sales

text: Everything else: billing questions, how-to questions, other data requests and smaller plan changes.
label: general_support
